title: Korean-Style Bibimbap
description: A flavorful and nutritious Korean rice bowl dish, perfect for a gluten-free meal. This version is a simplified take on the classic recipe, with a focus on fresh vegetables and a fried egg.

ingredients.name: assorted vegetables (bean sprouts, carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: Cook the Korean rice according to package instructions.
Prepare the assorted vegetables by washing and cutting them into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the frying oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the egg in the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the vegetable oil and sauté the vegetables until they are tender.
Add the bibimbap sauce to the pan and stir to combine with the vegetables.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of cooked rice into a bowl, followed by a spoonful of the vegetable mixture.
Top the dish with the fried egg and toasted sesame seeds.
